$comment: Licence policy for components shipped in the product (docs/adr/0002-licence-policy.md). Each exception names where its source is obtained, for THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES (scripts/third_party_notices.py, item 7.20). Tools that run beside the product and are not shipped in its images: age (BSD-3-Clause) and rclone (MIT) for backups, Prometheus and Alertmanager (Apache-2.0) for monitoring, Locust (MIT) for load tests; gpg (GPL) may replace age as an external program, never linked. Read by scripts/check_licences.py (Python) and scripts/check_npm_licences.mjs (web). Development and test tools that never ship are reported, not gated.

certifi.reason: The certificate authorities requests trusts, pulled in by pywebpush to reach the browsers' push services (item 4.04). Used unmodified.

psycopg.reason: The PostgreSQL driver Django supports. Used unmodified as a separately installed library.
psycopg.source: https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg (the sdist of the same version on https://pypi.org/project/psycopg/)

psycopg-binary.reason: Binary build of psycopg, same terms. Used unmodified.
psycopg-binary.source: https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg (built from the psycopg sources of the same version)

psycopg-pool.reason: Connection pool from the psycopg project, pulled in by procrastinate. Used unmodified.

py-vapid.reason: Signs push notices with GSA's VAPID key; part of pywebpush (item 4.04, ADR 0011). Used unmodified.

pyphen.reason: Hyphenation used by WeasyPrint. Offered under GPL, LGPL or MPL 1.1; GSA takes it under MPL 1.1, unmodified.

pywebpush.reason: Web Push: encrypts each notice for the one browser that subscribed (item 4.04, ADR 0011, decision D10). Used unmodified, as a separately installed library.

programs.$comment: Programs run beside the product as separate processes, never linked into it (ADR 0002, point 6). scripts/check_licences.py runs each check where the program is installed.

ffmpeg.reason: Converts lecture video to a low, a standard and a sound-only copy and takes the poster frame (items 4.06, 4.07; ADR 0015, decision D3). Built in api/Dockerfile from Debian's source with LGPL parts only (OpenH264, BSD-2-Clause, for H.264), and run as a separate program by the job worker.
ffmpeg.source: The Debian source package ffmpeg of the version in the image (https://sources.debian.org/src/ffmpeg/, apt-get source ffmpeg), built as api/Dockerfile records

openh264.reason: The H.264 encoder the FFmpeg build uses (libopenh264 from Debian), a shared library loaded by FFmpeg, never by the product. Listed so every program the product runs is named.

whisper.cpp.reason: Optional speech recognition for captions on GSA's own server (ADR 0015). Not in the image: GSA installs it and names it in VIDEO_TRANSCRIBE_COMMAND. Permissive; listed so every program the product runs is named.
